Center composition: a stack of digital comic book icons on a tablet screen with a play/read button, surrounded by a balanced cluster of small supporting icons (a 30%OFF discount tag, a calendar, a coin) so negative space is used efficiently. Bottom corner: small Japanese teaser label "次のスライド：よくある失敗とは？" next to a swipe-arrow icon. Limit to 3 colors (warm coral red, cream, deep brown accent) and 2 font weights. Clean modern flat vector design, no realistic photos, no logos, no copyrighted characters, no real manga titles.
